Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment was fully reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The methodology (OV matrix construction, word representation extraction, parallelogram arithmetic), experimental settings (raw, concept, token, all), expected results, and hyperparameters (k=80 heads, specific layers) were all clearly documented. No major guesswork was required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: The environment was reproducible. Model (Llama-2-7b-hf) was available in shared cache, pre-computed head scores were provided in cache/causal_scores/, and all required packages were available. Minor nnsight version incompatibility was resolved by using transformers directly - a valid reimplementation approach.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results were highly deterministic. All replicated accuracy values matched cached values exactly (0.0000 difference) for most experiments. One experiment (gram7 concept) had 0.0013 difference, within acceptable tolerance. No random seeds needed as computation is fully deterministic.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: This replication did not involve evaluating a demo. The repository provides scripts for running full experiments, and replication was performed by reimplementing core functionality and comparing against cached results.
